digest.component_or_area: Cloud/DC atomic executor — legacy-default seam integration
propositions: Constructor-injected legacy-default selector routes exact summary-only mutations to bypass generic retry while mixed-field mutations remain on single legacy call path.

Success dispositions (applied, recovered, already_satisfied) map to legacy result surface with key/jira_key, derive synced_fields from routed mutation's fields["summary"], and advance ADR-0026 baseline.

All non-success dispositions (commit_unknown, retryable_deferred, permanent_failure, exhausted_transient, and further terminal outcomes) record one redacted per-mutation error message capped at 512 Unicode code points without baseline/provenance advance.
Terminal outcomes carry retry_not_before on manifest for observability, keep _fields_synced empty, persist no S1 deferral, and continue batch processing.
ADR 0103 section S1 names S3 as sole production cutover owner, fuse/deferral consumer, and compatibility-bridge retirement owner.
